files.item: A flyer used to advertise When Bristol Fought Back, May Day 2024.
files.notes: Adapted from 'Bristol Tramways Strike. Scene outside Brislington Depot during dispute' by E. Coffin, in The Apostle of Free Labour: The Life Story of William Collinson Founder and General Secretary of the National Free Labour Association, by William Collinson, 1913. This image was also used on the covers of the BRHG publication Bristol and the Labour Unrest of 1910-14, and for the miscellaneous 2024 event series web-poster.

files.item: Bristol Miners Support Group Archive leaflet 2024.
files.notes: This leaflet was used to appeal for artefacts related to the Bristol Miners Support Group, which formed during the 1984–85 miners strike. It features flyers, posters and photographs already collected for the archive.
